_comment: BindCraft filters, tightened for MtrE. Start from the default_filters.json
shipped with your BindCraft install and apply these overrides - do not assume
this file is complete, diff it against the shipped one first.
Rationale for each tightening relative to BindCraft defaults:
i_pTM 0.50 -> 0.65   the single most predictive metric; cheap to tighten
ShapeComplementarity 0.55 -> 0.62   a plug in an open barrel can score well
on pAE while barely touching the wall; sc_ catches that
Surface_Hydrophobicity 0.35 -> 0.30  these binders go on a bacterial cell
surface in the presence of LOS; sticky designs are a liability and
hydrophobic designs are exactly what a membrane-protein target
n_InterfaceUnsatHbonds 3 -> 2   buried unsatisfied polars are the usual
reason a confident-looking design has no measurable affinity
n_InterfaceResidues 7 -> 12   forces real buried surface, not a kiss
These will cut your accepted-design yield substantially. That is the point:
you are trading compute for a lower experimental false-positive rate, and
compute is much cheaper than 96 wells of protein expression.
